about.quote: Every matter is someone's life. We treat it that way.

about.summary: Mohd. Moin Ahmed Quadri enrolled at the Bar in 1997 and has practised from Narayanguda since. He appears before the High Court for the State of Telangana. Every client meets Mr. Quadri himself.
about._summary: Shown on phones (below 640 px) in place of the three paragraphs.
paragraphs: Mohd. Moin Ahmed Quadri enrolled at the Bar in 1997 and has practised from Narayanguda since. He appears before the High Court for the State of Telangana.
The chambers take civil, criminal, family, consumer and commercial matters. Every client meets Mr. Quadri himself.
Chambers sit in the evening, after court hours, so that clients can attend after their own working day.
